newsitem.title: USA: RFS comfortable with FFO 1997 estimate.
newsitem.headline: RFS comfortable with FFO 1997 estimate.

text.p: RFS Hotel Investors Inc's president, Minor Perkins, said the company was comfortable with analysts' projections for Funds from operation (FFO) per share of $2.05 to $2.06 for 1997.
"We are comfortable with that," he told Reuters at a Montgomery Securities Hospitality Conference in New York.
Perkins also said that the acquisition of four Sheraton hotels, completed in January this year was expected to be additive to earnings per share this year.
The Sheraton deal was worth about $90 million.
Perkins also said the company expects a Funds From Operations (FFO) return in 1997 of 12 percent and continued improvement thereafter.

Perkins said RFS will continue to pursue acquisition opportunities in 1997. "We expect we'll make substantial acquisitions this year," he told Reuters but declined to put in an amount on projected acquisition expenditure.

Perkins told the conference that the company was negotiating to increase its line of bank credit to $150 million from $75 million. He said the increased credit would be directed towards new acquistions.
